beforePause.dialog:
OPERATOR HANDBOOK
×
SWIPE INSTRUCTIONS ↑
MOVE WITH PURPOSE.
MOVE with the left thumb. Swipe the scene to turn quickly. Tap a visible enemy or coil to center your aim, then hold FIRE. FIRE drags make fine corrections; AIM slows them further.
PATH directions name the clear next step relative to your view; turn before walking. MAP pauses to plan. Within 8m of a receiver, release MOVE and hold APPROACH; release it to stop.
After three memories, destroy the numbered copper coils. Amber means cover; cyan means an exposed firing window. Move to a clear face.
When the jammer falls, return to the marked uplink deck and survive the upload. DASH helps reposition; JUMP becomes VAULT near low cover.
FULL TACTICAL HANDBOOK
UNDERSTOOD
↗
